@CryptoTimes_io Proof of work is still the best security model, you just have to make sure you're on the chain that has the most, which is Bitcoin.

Approximately 98% of all proof of work mining goes solely into securing Bitcoin.  The remainder is divided among bcash, bsv, dogecoin, litecoin,
